result.summary: The pedestrian environment is currently a construction zone adjacent to a rail line, lacking dedicated sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to navigate around construction equipment and barriers in a high-exposure area with poor pavement quality.

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Barriers, cones, and a large utility truck occupy the roadway and potential pedestrian paths.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or dedicated sidewalks are visible, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Rail Proximity
hazards.description: The roadway is immediately adjacent to rail tracks with no physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style marked crosswalks to define safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Construct Permanent Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant sidewalks to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically aimed at illuminating pedestrian paths and crossings.

result.summary: The environment is a high-speed commercial corridor with a wide multi-lane intersection and an at-grade railroad crossing. While a curb ramp and marked crosswalk are present, the pedestrian path is interrupted by tracks and lacks continuous paved surfaces and physical buffers from heavy traffic.

hazards.name: At-grade railroad crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross active railroad tracks with uneven surfaces and no dedicated pedestrian gates.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground, crossing the pedestrian path

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane arterial road requires a long unprotected crossing, increasing exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk
hazards.description: The paved sidewalk ends and transitions into a dirt/gravel area before reaching the main intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island at the wide intersection to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Railroad Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install smooth, level crossing surfaces and pedestrian-specific warning signals and gates at the tracks.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Pave the gap between the existing curb ramp and the intersection to provide a continuous, accessible path.

result.summary: This large, multi-lane commercial intersection is characterized by high-speed vehicle traffic and significant pedestrian exposure due to long crossing distances. While basic infrastructure like signals and sidewalks are present, the environment is currently compromised by construction activity and faded pavement markings.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Orange barriers and cones indicate a work zone that disrupts established pedestrian paths and waiting areas.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background and left side of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with high-visibility continental or ladder markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection is currently a construction zone with new sidewalk infrastructure that is not yet fully integrated with the roadway. Pedestrians face long crossing distances across multiple lanes with faded markings and no visible pedestrian signal heads.

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Orange barrels and construction equipment are placed in the roadway and near the pedestrian path, creating tripping hazards and narrowing the travel way.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground around the crossing area

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While signal poles are present, no pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide crossing guidance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.
